Make its visible open diameter about TWO TO THREE TIMES larger relative to the obelisk and city. The far lip must feel distant through atmospheric perspective, not close behind the tower. The broad impact depression goes beyond the left/lower frame; coherent concentric fractured geology, tiny mining galleries far below for scale. Preserve the recognizable city skyline on the RIGHT, straight tall iron obelisk anchored IMMEDIATELY at the upper rim, its size/design, pale stone and iron/copper architecture, working cranes and believable bridges. Keep blue and cream painted daylight and the same viewpoint family. No new buildings/landmarks, no change into a water lake or volcanic pit, no black flat patch or rectangular edit seam.

cities.request: Conserver les cascades, calmer le fond et ajouter deux arbres geants diagonaux evoquant des bois de cerf.
cities.subtitle: Les arbres-cornes et les cascades des Cerelf
cities.description: Deux arbres immenses aux branches de bois de cerf encadrent la cite et ses cascades ; le lointain est plus calme.
cities.edit: WOODLAND: Preserve the author's loved cascades, elegant ivory living-wood architecture, turquoise water, curved bridges, warm forest light and the city's relationship to giant living trees. Add TWO monumental living TREES with massive naturally DIAGONAL main trunks, branching in the recognizable sweeping silhouette of a PAIR OF GREAT STAG ANTLERS. These are real ancient trees, rough bark and leafy branch ends, not actual horns, bones, sculpted antler monuments or a deer character. One immense trunk rises diagonally outward to the left, the other diagonally outward to the right; their broad upper limbs curve upward and divide into a few antler-like tines. The TWO antler-tree silhouettes should be immediately legible in the upper half, with visible sky gaps; avoid an opaque foliage canopy hiding the shapes. Organic platforms and pale architectural arches wrap around their lower trunks, bridges join the inhabited sections below. This is the Cerelf city's recognizable natural landmark, elegant and believable. Simplify the FAR BACKGROUND strongly: no dozens of distant towers/castles, no repeated high-detail mountains or bridges; only two or three soft forested ridges, subdued sky and distant waterfall suggestion. Keep rich but controlled detail on the nearer trees, city and waterfalls, not everywhere. Do not turn the water into a bright flat graphic heart or import a new architecture style.

cities.request: Une grande ile montagneuse ; cite au sommet pres des nuages.
cities.subtitle: La cite au-dessus des nuages
cities.description: Kalistopolis occupe les terrasses d'un haut sommet insulaire, autour de son sanctuaire a fleche.
cities.edit: KALISTOPOLIS: The current tiny low rocky islet is WRONG in scale. Recompose this as a CITY ON THE HIGH SUMMIT OF A LARGE MOUNTAINOUS ISLAND, close to and above clouds. Preserve the unmistakable pale stone sanctuary with its tall straight faceted central spire, angled symmetrical buttresses, turquoise aged-copper roof tips and broad steps. It crowns a real massive mountain summit, with a modest but unmistakable inhabited city of smaller pale-stone houses and terraces stepping down the rock beneath it. Not only an isolated church and dock. The mountain extends continuously deep downward into layered cloud banks: show genuine towering rock walls and a winding supported stone approach. Lower ridges of the much larger island emerge from clouds in the distance, and only a thin far-away glimpse of ocean VERY FAR BELOW if visible at all. No close sea-level beach or little oval shoreline directly around the temple. Three-quarter elevated view across the summit at cloud height, temple and inhabited terraces central, ample cloud/sky breathing room, morning pearl and warm sunlit ivory against cool gray rock, muted turquoise roofs. Mountain is firmly attached to an island, NOT floating rock, a flying city or a palace sitting on clouds. Keep original sanctuary geometry rather than replacing it with a generic castle. Calm distant background, no dense skyline or giant magical gem.

cities.request: Conserver le dome mais reduire fortement la porte pour rendre son echelle immense.
cities.subtitle: Le dome immense et ses entrees humaines
cities.description: Le dome conserve sa silhouette, avec une toute petite entree a sa base qui rend son echelle monumentale.
cities.edit: ARBORIUM: The author loves essentially the ENTIRE TARGET. Keep exactly the huge low ribbed glass-and-living-wood dome, its position/shape, forest, river, bridges, houses, green/ivory/copper colors and warm light. Correct the SCALE OF THE ENTRANCE ONLY. This dome contains an immense city/garden, hundreds of meters across. The present huge pointed entrance suggests a small pavilion and is rejected. REMOVE that oversized door and its doorway-shaped tall ornamental surround, fill that area with the continuous dome ribs and glass structure. In its place at the very foot, put a TINY, human-scale pointed access portal about 1/6 to 1/8 the current door's height, roughly 2 percent of the dome height, on a small landing with normal-sized stairs, proportionate to nearby little houses. A few almost-dot-sized people near the door help show that scale, without foreground characters. Keep the larger structural arch/rib motif only as glass-bearing framework, NOT a huge open doorway pretending to be a small door. The dome remains immense and unchanged, no resizing it downward. No new skyline, no background detailing, no buildings replacing the dome or modern geodesic ribs.

cities.request: Une cite dans un volcan plutot que devant les volcans.
cities.subtitle: La cite dans le volcan
cities.description: Une cite draconique creusee en terrasses dans les parois d'une caldeira, au-dessus des coulees de lave.
cities.edit: VULKAR: Rework the topography so the CITY IS CLEARLY BUILT INSIDE A COLOSSAL VOLCANO CALDERA, not spread on a flat plateau in front of volcanoes. Preserve the same inhabited black basalt Drax city architecture, noble palace with curved horn-like forms, restrained ember-red openings, gray ash daylight, scarlet lava accents and dark water. Camera looks diagonally DOWN through a breach in the enormous crater rim: show the high inner volcanic walls encircling the settlement, foreground cliff rim and at least two distant rim sides, the city recessed BELOW this enclosing rim. City streets and buildings are carved/built on secure descending concentric terraces along the INNER walls. Central palace on a broad protected basalt shelf within the bowl. Deep below, a limited incandescent fissure and narrow controlled lava streams; a black volcanic lake lies on another LOWER shelf away from molten lava, visibly dark liquid water. Safe solid bridges connect inner inhabited terraces across real gaps. An active vent smokes on a remote rear crater flank, not an eruption engulfing residents. Two distant volcanic peaks may be glimpsed beyond the far rim but are calm simplified shapes, not main background spectacles. One readable giant inhabited caldera, not many unrelated cones. Enormous scale through tiny windows/terraced neighborhoods, substantial ash-black inner cliffs, clear architecture silhouettes against gray volcanic haze. Not a city floating in magma, no entire orange frame, no giant character, no generic castle outside the crater.

cities.request: Conserver la necropole mais l'enfoncer davantage dans le gouffre.
cities.subtitle: La necropole au fond du gouffre
cities.description: La croix et les quartiers funeraires descendent plus profond sous les parois du gouffre, dans le brouillard marin.
cities.edit: CRYPTOWN: Author approves architecture, cross, necropolis, candlelight, sea fog, painterly gray/violet palette. Keep that visual identity. SINK THE WHOLE CENTRAL CITY AND ITS CROSS MUCH DEEPER INTO THE ISLAND'S DARK PIT. The previous cross dominates above the rim as if built on top of a platform: this must change. Show a strong enclosing rocky upper rim across foreground/sides and far background, tall near-vertical interior cliff faces dropping beneath it, then the main funerary terraces and central cross SEVERAL LEVELS BELOW the rim. Even the top of the cross is BELOW the distant upper pit lip. Camera from high on the rim looking downward, the city below through thinning layers of fog; cross recognizable and readable in the lower-center, not tiny/invisible. Concentric cemetery neighborhoods descend deeper, central supporting rock column may remain but is itself recessed down inside the chasm. Stairways and bridges visibly connect to the inner walls. Sea and thick island-surrounding mist are seen outside the far rim only at the top of the image. Retain original carved stone crosses/tombs, sparse warm candles, subtle purple drapes, calm shadow depth, no lava or green skull glow. No dense buildings on the outer high rim; only sparse funerary markers there. The abyss is three-dimensional rock and mist, never an opaque black patch.

cities.request: Bulle et ville beaucoup plus grandes, capteurs de maintien repartis et habitations sous-marines en banlieue.
cities.subtitle: La grande bulle et ses quartiers sous-marins
cities.description: Une metropole sous une bulle immense, maintenue par des capteurs, avec des habitations sous-marines a l'exterieur.
cities.edit:
THALASSEA: Strongly ENLARGE the scale of the protected city and the BUBBLE, analogous to Arborium's immense scale. It must contain an entire sea-floor METROPOLIS and many varied small city blocks, not simply a huge palace filling a small snow globe. Preserve the central pale shell-like ribbed palace and elegant slender towers as the recognizable landmark, but make them a smaller central district inside the vast bubble. Human-scale doorways and windows tiny relative to it. Pull the viewpoint back enough to read the entire great transparent spherical membrane and the sprawl within, sitting on the real deep OCEAN FLOOR. Show 6-8 clearly purposeful CAPTORS/STABILIZERS at distributed points: elegant small bronze-and-stone anchored pylons around the seabed perimeter, curved receptor heads, contained turquoise crystalline energy cells. Four or more visible devices project thin faint converging energy connections into corresponding distinct attachment nodes on the bubble surface, including left, right and upper flanks. These clearly MAINTAIN THE BUBBLE; not random spotlights, radar dishes, giant laser cannons or a modern sci-fi station. Technology integrated into ancient fantasy craftsmanship, contained glow not giant neon beam grid.
NEW OUTER SUBURBS outside the main bubble: several clusters of true UNDERWATER DWELLINGS on terraced coral/stone seabed, shell-and-coral inspired enclosed houses and small habitat pods with watertight curved windows, connected by low sea-floor paths and a few transparent connecting tunnels. Some dwellings actually outside the main barrier, not hidden inside it, not dry ordinary houses exposed impossibly to water or surface islands. Different scale: the outer homes and stabilizer pylons small compared with the immense main city bubble. Clear slanting underwater daylight, rich but restrained teal water, pearl stone, a few warm windows and coral accents. Keep far seascape calm and soft, avoid hundreds of equally detailed micro-towers, no ruins/coral clutter dominating foreground, no close-up hero or modern submarine.
